'''Football Club Slivnishki Geroy''' ({{langx|bg|ФК "Сливнишки герой"|lit=FC Hero of Slivnitsa}}) is a Bulgarian association [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Slivnitsa]], [[Sofia Province]], which competes in the [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|South-West Third League]]. Their home ground since 1966 has been Slivnishki Geroy Stadium. The club has played in its traditional blue and white stripes throughout most of its history."}}
